Jurisdiction: 1. Original data for BreastScreen Australia service locations included all sites delivering screening from 2021 to 2023, as well as sites expected to deliver screening in 2024. Data were received from state and territory BreastScreen organisations between July and October 2023.
2. Service frequency describes the frequency at which the accessibility of screening sites was measured, for women needing to access a site.
3. Population estimates were modelled by the AIHW, based primarily on Australian Bureau of Statistics (ABS) population data. The reference point for the population is 30 June 2021.
4. Drive times were calculated using ArcGIS StreetMap Premium Asia Pacific 2023 Release 1.
5. Geographic boundaries are from the Australian Statistical Geography Standard (ASGS) Edition 3.
6. Jervis Bay and Norfolk Island are presented within New South Wales; Christmas Island and Cocos (Keeling) Islands are presented within Western Australia.
Sources: AIHW analysis of ABS population data and state/territory BreastScreen service locations.
